verdict.rationale: Vercel offers Postgres only via a third-party Marketplace partner (Neon), described as 'serverless Postgres... with autoscaling and instant branching' rather than a Vercel-native fully-managed service with explicit point-in-time recovery, replicas, or HA guarantees. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of PITR, replica configuration, and HA SLAs, and any confirmation these features are exposed through the Vercel-integrated product rather than left to Neon's own console.
